data.revised_prompt:
Edit the provided scientific diagram image with a small, precise correction only. Preserve the clean v1 layout, typography, modules, thumbnails, title, colors, and SCI-journal style. Do NOT redesign or move major boxes.

Goal: correct only the red backward-gradient routing in the simplified active-depth model.

Required changes:
- Keep the red label near the loss block: "gradient to P, E, G".
- Make the red backward-gradient path go only from L_sens / L_teach to the camera registers c=[P,E,G] (via the observed outputs path if needed). A clean route is acceptable: L_sens/L_teach -> D_obs/Q_obs -> Q/M -> S_phi -> P,E,G.
- Remove any red backward-gradient arrows going to speed ||v_t||.
- Remove any red backward-gradient arrows going to scene / material mask Omega.
- Remove any red backward-gradient arrows going to D_raw, native geometry, or renderer R.
- Keep all black forward arrows from speed, Omega, D_raw, and P/E/G into S_phi or factor chips unchanged.
- Keep the gray note inside the left panel: "geometry and mask treated as fixed in sensor backward" or equivalent.
- Add or preserve a gray note near the bottom right: "no gradients to D_raw, Omega, speed, or renderer R".
- Preserve the straight-through mask block and all observed output blocks.

Make the correction minimal and precise, with no extra formulas, no clutter, and no style changes beyond the red gradient routing and the gray note. Ensure no red arrows touch speed, Omega, scene mask, raw depth, native geometry, or renderer R except the intended red path to P,E,G only.
